explanation: This Python module mirrors the pinned Apache Commons Codec Hex class behavior. It defines `run(operation, data, lower=True)` to handle encoding lists of unsigned byte integers to hexadecimal strings and decoding hexadecimal strings to lists of unsigned byte integers. `Character.digit(ch, 16)` behavior is replicated in Python using ascii/latin range checks combined with `unicodedata.digit()` to handle non-ASCII Unicode digits correctly. Appropriate `ValueError` exceptions are raised on odd-length input or invalid hex digits matching Java's exception logic.
